astra_plans.reasoning_summary: Use a northern detour around the robot base, avoiding the XRD and carrying the upright vial above the racks rather than over tall instruments. Grasp height is 0.9473 m, calculated from the supplied 0.114 m vial height. Place the vial bottom on the worktop at z=0.896 m and retreat vertically by 0.12 m. The supplied initial TCP is already inside the 0.32 m minimum horizontal radius (0.307 m); the first move exits this region, and all commanded targets satisfy the usable-radius limits.

safety_checks: All commanded TCP targets are within the 0.32–0.75 m usable-radius bounds; the initial supplied pose requires the disclosed departure exception.
Keep tool_down=true and yaw constant throughout; no pouring or intentional vial tilt.
Use a conservative 20 mm vial diameter for clearance checks despite the smaller supplied AABB width.
Maintain at least 0.03 m clearance from unrelated AABBs; intended vial grasp and bench support are contact exceptions.
At pickup, a conservative 20 mm vial envelope remains 0.052 m in front of the XRD AABB.
At placement, the conservative vial envelope remains 0.11 m in front of the balance AABB.
Interpolate translation in increments no greater than 0.020 m and enforce orientation deviation no greater than 0.25 rad.
Before execution, validate full-arm IK, gripper envelope, and swept-volume collisions; TCP and object checks alone do not certify robot-link clearance.

astra_plans.reasoning_summary: Execute a safe partial plan: pick holder_0 from above and lift it horizontally, then hold. Full placement cannot be certified with the supplied grasp geometry: a TCP aligned with the disc centre would need y=-3.614, exceeding the permitted TCP insertion limit y=-3.584 by 0.030 m. Also, changing a rigid top grasp to tool_down=false would tilt the disc rather than keep it horizontal. Completing insertion requires a validated horizontal-tool grasp transform or regrasp that preserves disc orientation and supplies sufficient forward offset. No unverified offset or orientation change is assumed.

waypoints.name: safe_hold_pending_insertion_grasp
waypoints.clearance_note: Continue vertically to a clear holding position. Stop here without rotating, entering the chamber, or releasing the unsupported holder.
